title: Jesus... What If I Stopped Believing Tomorrow?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, what if I stopped believing tomorrow?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I am not even angry. I am just empty.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: That is harder than angry. Angry still has fire in it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So You are not going to argue with me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. You have argued with yourself all week. You lost both sides.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I keep showing up and feeling nothing.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Showing up while feeling nothing is not hypocrisy. It is faithfulness without the music.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: If you are faithless, I remain faithful. I cannot disown Myself, and you are Mine.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: That sounds like You will not let me leave.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It sounds like your grip was never what held this together. Rest. Mine is still here tomorrow.

bible.text: if we are faithless, he will remain faithful, for he cannot disown himself.
